bio.body1: I work on natural language processing — text-document and text-stream analysis, semi-automatic data exploration, and visualization of text data.
bio.body2: Senior Researcher at the <link1>Department for Artificial Intelligence</link1>, Jožef Stefan Institute. Data Scientist at <link2>Event Registry</link2>. Teaching assistant at the <link3>Jožef Stefan International Postgraduate School</link3>.
